publisher: Broward County Property Appraiser (BCPA) via Broward County GIS, parcel polygons joined to tax roll
notes: BCPA parcel polygons joined with tax roll (monthly). address is the owner mailing address line (ADDRESS_LINE_1); situs fields are SITUS_STREET_NUMBER/SITUS_STREET_DIRECTION/SITUS_STREET_NAME. assessed_value is just land value. Very large polygons (water/conservation areas) excluded.
